silhouette.reason: Long pointed ears, hooked nose, bald dome with grey wisps and a thin neck read as a goblin in FRONT and SIDE; the shoulders are two round brown balloons with no garment shape, so the bust outline below the neck is generic.
fixes: give the vest a cut shoulder seam and collar edge in the side profile instead of the inflated shoulder ellipsoids
a stronger forward hunch of the neck in the SIDE view

proportions.reason: Head, ears and nose sit well; the neck is long and pole-straight in SIDE, and the shoulder masses are oversized against the narrow skull (wider than the ear span).
fixes: narrow the shoulder masses ~15 % and drop them 2 cm so the neck shortens
widen the grin and show the teeth row (mouth reads pursed)

materials.reason: Skin, vest, shirt and scarf separate by hue only; vest leather, linen shirt and wool scarf share one soft sheen; the scarf reads as red rubber tubing with a ball knot.
fixes: leather strip with grain and edge darkening on the vest
wool/knit strip and fraying on the scarf; flatten its round-tube section into a folded band

detail.reason: Warts, brow creases, lids, ear notches and hair wisps hold at third person; vest and shirt are smooth masses with no seams, stitches or buttons.
fixes: seams, hem stitching and a toggle on the vest
thicker ear rim at LOD0 so the cartilage edge reads

wear.reason: Some skin mottling and red ear tips; clothes are clean and unpatched.
fixes: patches, grime and frayed edges on the vest

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 in sheet.png loses both ears and the hair wisps: the head becomes a bald egg, so the goblin read pops away at distance.
fixes: keep the ears as a two-plane card (or a 6-segment cone) at LOD2
keep a single hair card at LOD2

technical.reason: QA clean on all LODs; 84k / 17k / 3.6k tris, heavy for a bust and spent largely on the smooth shoulder masses.
fixes: cut the shoulder balloons to ~5k tris and spend on ear rims
declare the warts from their seeded sizes instead of a 2× bound
